notes: The C gsay row is POS_SLEEPING with no command minimum level.
The C gtell row shares do_gsay with gsay and preserves the same POS_SLEEPING, level-zero gate.
The shared POS_SLEEPING command rejection is owned by the existing group position-gate vehicle.
The gtell alias uses the same shared POS_SLEEPING command rejection.
A caller without AFF_GROUP receives the exact group-membership refusal before argument handling.
The gtell row reaches the same do_gsay group-membership refusal.
An in-group caller with no argument receives the exact empty group-say prompt.
The gtell alias preserves the same empty-argument prompt.
A grouped leader reaches all grouped followers and receives the exact self confirmation.
The adjacent gtell row shares the handler and emits identical leader/follower audience bytes.
Grouped recipients still receive the message while PRF_NOREPEAT changes only the actor confirmation to C's Okay. text.

A sleeping grouped listener still gets the line (TO_SLEEP), and C names the speaker because CAN_SEE has no AWAKE test (utils.h:515-530); the port's canSee treats a sleeping observer as blind and prints Someone. Exposed when gsay moved onto act(); the fix is DP-1295's CAN_SEE port (R1).
C preserves internal argument whitespace through the group broadcast and self confirmation.
C delete_ansi_controls strips every ampersand from the formatted sender and recipient messages.
TO_CHAR act delivery preserves the C self-echo line ending and color wrapping.
Act substitution renders an invisible player as Someone for grouped recipients.
Leader-first delivery follows C follower-list prepend order.
TO_VICT|TO_SLEEP delivers to a grouped sleeping follower.

With complete colour, C wraps each listener's line in CCWHT/CCNRM at C_CMP and the speaker's echo in CCWHT at C_SPR / CCNRM at C_NRM, the reset after act's whole line, line ending included. Proved with keep-ansi (the earlier '# keep-ansi' was a comment, so colour was never compared, and the echo's reset sat before the line ending) (R1).
C sends each awake or sleeping listener a fresh prompt after the group line (process_output flushes every descriptor with pending output); the port sends none. DP-1307, async prompts (R1).
When the speaker's output ends with a colour reset after the line ending, C prompts on the next line and the port adds one more blank line first. Prompt-spacing class (DP-1308) (R1).
